s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Premier Energies' N-Type TOPCon solar cell facility?
o: TOPCon stands for Tunnel Oxide Passivated Contact
Its cells work through the photovoltaic effect
The company's total capacity after the opening was described as India's highest
The G12R cell plant opened on 21 September 2026 has a capacity of 10.6 GW
x: The new plant is 7 GW; 10.6 GW is the company's total capacity after the opening.

s: Which body received the renewable-energy investment mobilisation award on behalf of Andhra Pradesh?
x: M. Kamalakar Babu received the award on behalf of NREDCAP, not the AP Pollution Control Board.

s: Which award category did Andhra Pradesh receive at Windergy India 2026?
o: Renewable Energy State for Rural Infrastructure
Leadership State in Renewable Energy Investment Mobilisation
Leadership State in Green Hydrogen Manufacturing
Best State in Wind Turbine Production
x: Andhra Pradesh received the Leadership State in Renewable Energy Investment Mobilisation award. The other descriptions are not the award category specified for the event.

s: Since June 2024, what clean-energy project and employment figures were associated with Andhra Pradesh’s renewable-energy mobilisation?
o: 97 projects, about ₹4 lakh crore and about 4.71 lakh jobs
97 projects, ₹1 lakh crore and 3.27 crore jobs
x: Since June 2024, the mobilisation involved 97 clean-energy projects, approximately ₹4 lakh crore and about 4.71 lakh jobs. The other options combine figures from irrigation, horticulture, water-supply or household-coverage details.

s: What was the theme of the 8th Windergy India 2026, held from 7 to 9 October 2026 in Chennai?
o: Quantum System for Hardware Integration, Validation and Architecture
x: The theme was “Wind—Powering India's Energy Resilience.” The other options refer to the Jal Jeevan Mission, the expansion of Q-SHIVA, or an award category rather than the Windergy theme.

s: Which organisations organised Windergy India 2026?
o: MNRE, Ministry of Power and Indian Wind Turbine Manufacturers Association
Ministry of Jal Shakti, MNRE and NREDCAP
Indian Institutes of Technology, Qubit Force and SSO Polymers
Ministry of Power, NREDCAP and Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board
x: Windergy India 2026 was organised by MNRE, the Ministry of Power and the Indian Wind Turbine Manufacturers Association. The other combinations include organisations linked to water, quantum technology or Andhra Pradesh renewable-energy administration.

s: Andhra Pradesh's 1,162.80 MW of feeder-level solarisation through 228 solar plants falls under which PM-KUSUM component?
x: Feeder-level solarisation is under Component C (FLS); Component B provides standalone solar pumps.

s: Where did Premier Energies inaugurate its N-Type TOPCon solar cell facility described as India’s largest?
o: Madakasira in Sri Sathya Sai district
Penukonda in Sri Sathya Sai district
x: Premier Energies inaugurated the facility at Naidupeta in Tirupati district, and it was billed as India’s largest N-Type TOPCon solar cell facility. Madakasira, Penukonda and Pullareddygudem are associated with other Andhra Pradesh news items, not this facility.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about feeder-level solarisation under PM-KUSUM?
o: Under the CAPEX mode, the utility owns the project
Under the CAPEX mode, a service company owns the project
Under the RESCO mode, a service company operates the project
The RESCO mode has a normal period of 25 years
x: In the CAPEX mode the utility, not a service company, owns the project; the service company belongs to the RESCO mode (normal period 25 years).

s: What is the Central Financial Assistance (CFA) under Andhra Pradesh's feeder-level solarisation project under PM-KUSUM?
o: 30% of project cost, capped at ₹2 crore/MW
50% of project cost, capped at ₹1.05 crore/MW
30% of project cost, capped at ₹1.05 crore/MW
70% of project cost, capped at ₹1.05 crore/MW
x: The CFA is 30% of project cost, subject to a ceiling of ₹1.05 crore per MW; feeder-separation loans may come from NABARD, PFC, REC or RDSS.

s: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan, or PM-KUSUM, is associated with which Union ministry?
o: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
x: PM-KUSUM stands for Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan and is associated with the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy. The other ministries are not identified with PM-KUSUM in this context.

s: What is the capacity range of decentralised grid-connected plants under Component A of PM-KUSUM?
x: Component A covers 500 kW–2 MW plants; Component C-IPS covers individual pump solarisation up to twice the pump capacity.

s: Which combination of topics was discussed during the India–Denmark Energy Partnership engagement concerning Amaravati's power grid?
o: Quantum computing, semiconductors, BioValley and Blue Economy
Coffee cultivation, tribal pensions, NEET coaching and Jan Aushadhi Kendras
Grid capacity, renewable integration, Distributed Energy Resources, Battery Energy Storage Systems and EV charging
Road construction, rooftop solar for houses, ambulances and welfare convergence
x: The discussions covered grid capacity, renewable integration, Distributed Energy Resources, Battery Energy Storage Systems and EV charging. The other combinations draw from tribal development or PanIIT Summit themes.

s: Along with the Danish Energy Agency and Green Power Denmark, which Indian body was part of the delegation shown Amaravati's digital twin?
x: The delegation comprised the Danish Energy Agency, Green Power Denmark and the Central Electricity Authority; the digital twin was shown at the Amaravati Integrated Command Control Centre.

s: The renewable-energy projects approved by Andhra Pradesh were processed under which policy and by which agencies?
o: Andhra Pradesh Clean Energy Policy; NTCA and ASI
Andhra Pradesh Clean Energy Policy; NREDCAP and APTRANSCO
x: The approvals were under the Andhra Pradesh Clean Energy Policy, with NREDCAP and APTRANSCO identified in connection with them. NTCA and ASI are associated with other subjects, not these renewable-energy approvals.

s: What type of project was Megha Engineering's cancelled 2,000 MW project at Kommuru in Annamayya district?
x: The cancelled Megha Engineering project at Kommuru was a 2,000 MW pumped-hydro project, not a solar project.

s: During the India–Denmark Energy Partnership visit to Amaravati, what project was discussed with APCRDA at its headquarters in Rayapudi?
o: Design of a 33-kV power grid for Amaravati
A digital twin of Amaravati at the Amaravati Integrated Command Control Centre
EV charging under the Amaravati power grid
A Research and Recommendation Paper for CM N. Chandrababu Naidu
x: The Danish delegation met APCRDA at its headquarters in Rayapudi to discuss the design of a 33-kV power grid for Amaravati. The digital twin was shown separately at the Amaravati Integrated Command Control Centre, while EV charging was one of the topics considered for the grid.

s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Clean Energy Policy, which approved project is associated with M. Venkata Rao Infra Projects?
o: A 118.80 MW solar project at Kasanur and Balapanur in YSR Kadapa district
A 675 MW solar project at Madakasira in Sri Sathya Sai district
A 24 TPD CBG project at Midthur in Nandyal district
A 100 MW wind-solar hybrid project at Yemmiganur in Kurnool district
x: M. Venkata Rao Infra Projects received approval for a 675 MW solar project at Madakasira in Sri Sathya Sai district. The other options refer to projects of Clean Renewable Energy Hybrid-6, Sai Bioenergy AP and Risalven Two Energy, respectively.

s: Where is the AM Green Ammonia project financed by the ADB and Japan located?
x: ADB and Japan signed financing with AM Green Ammonia for a green ammonia project at Kakinada.

s:
Consider the following statements about the Kakinada green ammonia project:
1. Its capacity is about 1.1 million tonnes a year.
2. It is the first investment under ACCEL.
3. Its loan comes via LEAP 2, administered by JICA.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: Capacity is about 1.1 million tonnes a year and it is ACCEL's first investment; LEAP 2 is funded by JICA but administered by ADB.

s: To which company did the 800 MW Avuku pumped storage project, cancelled by the Cabinet in September 2026, belong?
x: The Cabinet cancelled RVR Projects' 800 MW Avuku PSP; Megha Engineering's cancelled project was at Kommuru.

s: What is the capacity of Premier Energies' N-Type TOPCon cell plant at Naidupeta?
x: The Naidupeta plant is 7 GW; 10.6 GW is the company's total cell capacity.

s: Which component of PM-KUSUM provides for standalone (off-grid) solar pumps?
x: Component B covers standalone solar pumps, with Centre 30% and State at least 30%.

s: Where is the 24 TPD compressed biogas (CBG) project of Sai Bioenergy AP approved under the AP Clean Energy Policy?
x: Sai Bioenergy AP's 24 TPD CBG project is at Midthur in Nandyal district.

s: AM Green Ammonia (India), which is setting up a green ammonia project at Kakinada, was set up by the founders of which group?
x: Hyderabad-based AM Green Ammonia was set up by the founders of the Greenko Group.

s: Where is the headquarters of the Asian Development Bank (ADB)?
x: ADB, set up in 1966, has its HQ at Mandaluyong, Metro Manila; JICA's HQ is Tokyo.

s: Green ammonia is produced from green hydrogen and which other input?
x: Green ammonia = green hydrogen + nitrogen taken from air.

s: Which of the following crops is included among those associated with the Global Horticulture Hub?
x: Dragon Fruit is one of the listed crops, along with mango, banana, tomato, pomegranate, avocado and berries. Wheat, tea and cotton are not included in the specified crop list.

s: The Global Horticulture Hub–Rayalaseema Rising project covers 10 districts, 5,869 villages and how many mandals?
x: It covers 303 mandals; 201 is the number of horticulture clusters.

s: Where was the 'Global Horticulture Hub–Rayalaseema Rising' project launched on 2 October 2026?
x: It was launched at Madanapalle; the foundation stone of the Indian School of Agriculture was laid the same day.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Rayalaseema horticulture initiative?
o: It includes 9 lakh acres of new irrigation potential
It seeks to raise horticulture production from 222 lakh MT to 435 lakh MT
It projects Andhra Pradesh as a 'fruit bowl' in place of its 'rice bowl' identity
It includes stabilisation of 4.3 lakh acres
x: AP is projected as a fruit bowl alongside, not in place of, its rice bowl identity.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Global Horticulture Hub–Rayalaseema Rising project?
o: It is valued at about ₹1 lakh crore
Its private investment share is larger than its government share
x: The project is not fully government-funded; private investment forms the larger share.

s: Which of the following pairs relating to the ASUSE district data is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Highest share of women-owned enterprises in AP – Prakasam
Highest share of women workers in AP – Nandyal
Districts nationally with women-worker share above 33% – 237
x: Nandyal, not Prakasam, had the highest share of women-owned enterprises (and of women workers and registered firms) in AP.

s: Under BHAVYA-related industrial park development in Andhra Pradesh, agreements were signed between which two organisations?
o: DGFT and the Department of Commerce
The Ministry of Commerce and Industry and NABARD
APIIC and the Ministry of Finance
x: The agreements were between APIIC and NICDIT. The other options combine organisations or departments associated with different facts and do not identify the agreement partners.

s: How many sector-specific industrial parks will Andhra Pradesh receive under BHAVYA?
x: Andhra Pradesh is to receive 11 parks under BHAVYA; the Robotics Park is in Sri Sathya Sai and the Semiconductor Park in Tirupati.

s: According to the Andhra Pradesh export data for 2025–26, which erstwhile district ranked first?
x: Visakhapatnam ranked first among the erstwhile districts of Andhra Pradesh in exports during 2025–26. East Godavari, Chittoor and Guntur followed it in the list.

s: The Andhra Pradesh export data for 2025–26 was sourced from which organisation, whose headquarters are in Kolkata?
o: Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics
x: The source was the Directorate General of Commercial Intelligence and Statistics, or DGCIS, under the Ministry of Commerce, headquartered in Kolkata. The Central Building Research Institute and Raj Path Infrastructure relate to other news items.

s: Which of the following is the correct group of major exports from Andhra Pradesh in 2025–26?
o: Marine products, pharma, organic chemicals, petroleum, rice, ferro-alloys, chillies and sugar
Marine products, textiles, tea, coffee, petroleum, rice, coal and sugar
Pharma, automobiles, iron ore, wheat, cotton, spices, cement and sugar
Organic chemicals, electronics, tea, rubber, rice, gold, chillies and coffee
x: The major exports included marine products, pharma, organic chemicals, petroleum, rice, ferro-alloys, chillies and sugar. The other groups replace several of these commodities with items not identified among the major exports.

s: As per the ASUSE district data, which Andhra Pradesh district recorded the highest annual wage of ₹1,99,783?
x: Kakinada recorded the highest annual wage; Kurnool recorded the lowest at ₹1,11,549.

s: As per ASUSE district data, which district had the highest number of enterprises in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Prakasam led AP in enterprises, YSR Kadapa led in workers, and Rangareddy led Telangana in enterprises.

s: How many acres have been allotted for Andhra Pradesh's BHAVYA industrial parks?
x: AP's 11 BHAVYA parks have 4,757 acres allotted; 3,488 acres is the Dugarajapatnam cluster site.

s: What rank did Andhra Pradesh hold among Indian States in exports in 2025-26?
x: AP ranked 7th with ₹1.77 lakh crore (4.53%); Gujarat was 1st and Kerala 15th.

s: With which organisation is the Indian School of Agriculture, whose foundation was laid with the Global Horticulture Hub launch, being set up?
x: The Indian School of Agriculture is being set up with Reliance, modelled on ISB.

s:
Match the following BHAVYA parks of Andhra Pradesh with their districts:
A. Aluminium Park
B. Robotics Park
C. Semiconductor Park
1. Tirupati
2. Srikakulam
3. Sri Sathya Sai
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
x: Aluminium Park is in Srikakulam, the Robotics Park in Sri Sathya Sai and the Semiconductor Park in Tirupati.

s: Which country was the largest destination of Andhra Pradesh's exports in 2025-26?
x: The USA was AP's largest export destination (₹35,970 crore) in 2025-26.

s: As per ASUSE district data, which district of Andhra Pradesh had the most workers?
x: YSR Kadapa had the most workers (3.26 lakh), while Prakasam had the most enterprises.

s: What is the full form of BHAVYA, under which Andhra Pradesh gets 11 industrial parks?
o: Bharat Hub for Advanced Value-added Yards
x: BHAVYA = Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana; AP gets 11 parks on 4,757 acres.

s: Which southern State was NOT in the top 10 exporting States in 2025-26?
x: All southern States except Kerala were in the top 10; Kerala was 15th.

s: From which date did India's Foreign Trade Policy 2023 come into effect?
x: The Foreign Trade Policy 2023 became effective on 1 April 2023.

s: The Mulapeta greenfield state port is located in which district?
x: Mulapeta is a state port in Srikakulam; Ramayapatnam is in Prakasam district.

s: Which company is building the Machilipatnam greenfield state port?
x: MEIL is building Machilipatnam, while Kakinada Gateway Port is an Aurobindo Group multi-cargo facility under PPP.

s: Which of the following is NOT one of Andhra Pradesh's four greenfield Other Than Major Ports (OTMPs)?
x: Visakhapatnam is AP's only major port; the four greenfield OTMPs are Ramayapatnam, Mulapeta, Machilipatnam and Kakinada Gateway, due by end-2027.

s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
x: Ramayapatnam Port is associated with Prakasam district in the progress table. Machilipatnam is in Krishna, Mulapeta in Srikakulam and Kakinada Gateway Port is in the Kakinada region.

s: Under the Indian Ports Act, 2025, the port limits of which two Andhra Pradesh ports were cut to 15 km?
x: Machilipatnam and Ramayapatnam had their port limits cut to 15 km under the Indian Ports Act, 2025. Mulapeta and Kakinada Gateway are other ports under construction; Juvvaladinne and Uppada are fishing harbours.

s: Andhra Pradesh aims to become the maritime gateway of which part of India?
x: The aim is to be the gateway of the east coast, bridging the container gap on the Haldia–Visakhapatnam–Chennai corridor.

s: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd, which proposes a merchant shipyard at Dugarajapatnam, is which category of PSU under the Ministry of Defence?
x: Mazagon Dock is a Navratna PSU; NSHIP-AP is owned equally by the AP Maritime Board and Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

s: Where is the greenfield merchant shipyard proposed under the MoU between Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd and NSHIP-AP?
x: The proposed greenfield merchant shipyard will be located at Dugarajapatnam in Tirupati district. Visakhapatnam, Kakinada and Anakapalli are associated with other facts but are not the stated location of this shipyard.

s: What is the annual capacity of the proposed Mazagon Dock merchant shipyard at Dugarajapatnam?
x: The shipyard's capacity is 1.2 million gross tonnes a year; MDL's investment is about ₹15,000 crore with about 45,000 jobs.

s: Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 aims to place India among the top how many shipbuilders of the world by 2047?
x: Maritime Amrit Kaal Vision 2047 aims for India to be among the top 5 shipbuilders by 2047, not the top 3.

s: Which statement correctly describes Visakhapatnam port in relation to Andhra Pradesh’s port network?
o: It is Andhra Pradesh’s only major port, with throughput of around 100 MTPA
It is Andhra Pradesh’s first greenfield OTMP, with throughput of around 200 MTPA
It is a state port in Prakasam district, with throughput of around 50 MTPA
It is a multi-cargo PPP facility in Kakinada SEZ, with throughput of around 16 MTPA
x: Visakhapatnam is Andhra Pradesh’s only major port and handles around 100 MTPA. The tempting option mentioning a multi-cargo PPP facility refers to Kakinada Gateway Port, not Visakhapatnam.

s: What is Andhra Pradesh's rank in cargo handled by Other Than Major Ports (OTMPs)?
x: AP ranks second after Gujarat with 16% of OTMP cargo; OTMPs handle nearly 50% of India's port cargo.

s: NSHIP-AP, the SPV for the Dugarajapatnam shipyard, is owned equally by the AP Maritime Board and which other body?
x: NSHIP-AP is owned equally by the AP Maritime Board and the Visakhapatnam Port Authority.

s: Which company is developing the Kakinada Gateway Port?
x: Kakinada Gateway Port is an Aurobindo Group PPP project; Machilipatnam port is being built by MEIL.

s: How much cargo did Andhra Pradesh ports handle in 2025-26?
x: AP ports handled about 210 MMT; 91.17 MMT was Visakhapatnam port's, and 327.5 MMT is the combined capacity.

s: To what level does Andhra Pradesh plan to raise the cargo capacity of its OTMPs by the end of 2027?
x: Four greenfield OTMPs are to double OTMP capacity from 100 MTPA to 200 MTPA by the end of 2027.

s: How much is Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Ltd to invest in the merchant shipyard at Dugarajapatnam?
x: MDL will invest about ₹15,000 crore over 5-7 years; ₹29,254 crore is the feasibility cost of the whole shipyard.

s: Which Act provides for Major Port Authorities, such as the Visakhapatnam Port Authority?
x: Major ports come under the Union and are governed by the Major Port Authorities Act, 2021; non-major ports are under the States.

s: What was reported after chloroquine tablets were administered at a medical camp in Polavaram district?
o: A 7-year-old girl died and 52 people, including 47 children, fell ill
A 7-year-old girl died and 23 people, including 15 children, fell ill
A 10-year-old boy died and 52 people, including 47 children, fell ill
A 7-year-old girl was injured and 52 people, including 47 children, were hospitalised
x: A 7-year-old girl died and 52 people, including 47 children, fell ill after the tablets were administered. The alternatives alter the age, number of affected persons, or outcome reported.

s: What is the scientific name of the Indian gaur?
x: The gaur is Bos gaurus; it is in WPA Schedule I, IUCN Vulnerable and CITES Appendix I.

s: The Valmiki Caves associated with Gooty are located near which of the following places and geographical features?
o: Gooty Fort on the Gooty–Mantralayam Road in the Erramala hills of Rayalaseema
Papikonda National Park along the Godavari in the northern Eastern Ghats
Pulicat Lake between Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu
x: The Valmiki Caves are near Gooty Fort on the Gooty–Mantralayam Road, in the Erramala hills of Rayalaseema. Papikonda, Pulicat Lake and Vaikuntham Queue Complex are different places associated with other events.

s:
Assertion (A): The Penukonda inscription belongs to the reign of Bukka Raya I.
Reason (R): The inscription is written in ancient Sanskrit.
o: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is NOT the correct explanation of A
A is true, but R is false
A is false, but R is true
x: Assertion A is true because the inscription records the reign of Bukka Raya I, who ruled from 1356 to 1377 CE. Reason R is false: the script is ancient Kannada-Telugu, not ancient Sanskrit.

s: What kind of monsoons after the last Ice Age, around 11,700 years ago, do oxygen isotopes in the Valmiki Caves stalagmites indicate?
x: The stalagmite oxygen isotopes show stronger monsoons after the last Ice Age, around 11,700 years ago.

s: Which distinctive feature is associated with the Valmiki Caves near Gooty?
o: All cave formations are shaped like conical pillars
The caves contain only smooth granite walls
The caves have no stalactites or stalagmites
Some cave formations sound like a tabla or bell
x: Some formations in the Valmiki Caves sound like a tabla or bell, and the cave system contains stalactites and stalagmites. The statement that the caves have no stalactites or stalagmites is therefore incorrect.

s: With reference to the Vijayanagara-era inscription found at Penukonda, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Nagula Bavi – Place where the inscription was found
Anantharasu Chikka Odeyar – Prime Minister of Bukka Raya I
Sri Naga Lingeshwara Swamy Temple – Well of Serpents
x: Anantharasu Chikka Odeyar was the Prime Minister of Bukka Raya I. The inscription was found at Sri Naga Lingeshwara Swamy Temple on Penukonda hill, and Nagula Bavi means Well of Serpents.

s: Penukonda, where a Vijayanagara-era inscription with eight Naga Kanyas worshipping Shiva was found, was which capital of the Vijayanagara Empire?
x: Penukonda was the second capital of the Vijayanagara Empire.

s: What was the reported rescue operation in Papikonda National Park?
o: A 750-kg female Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare at the Animal Rescue Centre in Visakhapatnam
A 750-kg male Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in the Eco-Sensitive Zone
A female Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in Pulicat Lake
A 750-kg female Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in the Eco-Sensitive Zone
x: A 750-kg female Indian gaur was rescued from a wire snare in the Eco-Sensitive Zone of Papikonda National Park. It was found during patrolling in Indukuru Reserve Forest, while the Animal Rescue Centre in Visakhapatnam provided care; it was not the rescue location.

s: Where does Papikonda National Park lie?
o: Northern Eastern Ghats along the Godavari
Southern Eastern Ghats along the Krishna
x: Papikonda lies in the northern Eastern Ghats along the Godavari, not in the Western Ghats.

s: Which vector is associated with Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Female Anopheles is the vector associated with Plasmodium falciparum.

s: The 10 new medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh are to be run under which model from 2027-28?
x: The 10 new medical colleges come up under PPP from 2027-28.

s: Which of the following is NOT among the 10 new PPP medical colleges in Andhra Pradesh?
x: The 10 are Adoni, Madanapalle, Markapuram, Pulivendula, Penugonda, Palakollu, Amalapuram, Narsipatnam, Bapatla and Parvatipuram; Ongole is not one.

s: On which festival are the Valmiki Caves near Gooty, linked to Sage Valmiki, worshipped?
x: The caves are worshipped on Maha Shivaratri; their underground water bodies are Edu Bavulu and Gundalu.

s: In which script is the 1363 CE Penukonda inscription of Bukka Raya I's reign written?
x: The Penukonda inscription is in ancient Kannada-Telugu script, not Sanskrit.

s: Under which Schedule of the Wild Life (Protection) Act is the Indian gaur listed?
x: The Indian gaur (Bos gaurus) is in WPA Schedule I, IUCN Vulnerable and CITES Appendix I.

s: What is the IUCN status of the Indian gaur?
x: The Indian gaur is IUCN Vulnerable, WPA Schedule I and CITES Appendix I.

s: The hills of which National Park in Andhra Pradesh were historically called the 'Bison Hills'?
x: Papikonda NP, along the Godavari in the northern Eastern Ghats, has hills historically called the Bison Hills.

s: What is the proposed output of the PanIIT Summit 2026 in Vijayawada?
o: A Research and Recommendation Paper to CM N. Chandrababu Naidu
The IIT Directors' Conclave under the PanIIT Amaravati Council
Five panels on Energy and fuel cost, DeepTech, Space and Defence manufacturing, BioValley, and AgriTech
x: The summit is to produce a Research and Recommendation Paper for CM N. Chandrababu Naidu. The IIT Directors' Conclave, five panels and leadership dinner are summit-related components, but they are not the stated output.

s: How many portable box-sized 4-Kelvin testing systems make up Q-SHIVA, unveiled at the Pan-IIT DeepTech Conference in Vijayawada?
x: Q-SHIVA comprises five portable box-sized 4-Kelvin testing systems made in India that cool in 1–2 hours.

s: Using the Q-SHIVA systems, universities can conduct up to what share of testing in-house?
x: Universities can conduct up to 80% of testing in-house with Q-SHIVA.

s: Google's AI hub at Visakhapatnam is being developed with which partners?
x: Google's 1 GW AI data-centre campus partners are AdaniConneX and Airtel Nxtra.

s: What is the planned initial capacity of the Google AI data-centre campus at Visakhapatnam?
x: The campus is 1 GW, with a long-term capacity of 5 GW.

s: The IBM Quantum Computing Centre at Amaravati Quantum Valley Tech Park is a partnership of Andhra Pradesh with IBM and which company?
x: The centre is an AP partnership with IBM and TCS, using IBM superconducting quantum processors.

s: 'The Anchorage', India's first private integrated testing facility for fully reusable medium-lift launch vehicles, is in which district?
x: The Anchorage is at Space City, Tirupati district, near SDSC SHAR, Sriharikota.

s: Which startup developed Q-SHIVA, India's first portable 4-Kelvin quantum testing systems?
x: Q-SHIVA's five systems were built by Qubit Force of Amaravati Quantum Valley; SSO Polymers was a component partner.

s: How much is Google to invest in its AI hub at Visakhapatnam over five years?
x: Google's AI hub at Visakhapatnam involves about $15 billion over five years, with a 1 GW data-centre campus.

s: What is the full form of Q-SHIVA, developed at Amaravati Quantum Valley?
o: Quantum System for Hardware Integration, Validation and Architecture
Quantum Superconducting Hub for Innovation and Validated Algorithms
Qubit System for High-Intensity Vacuum Analysis
Quantum Sensor for Hardware Imaging and Vibration Analysis
x: Q-SHIVA = Quantum System for Hardware Integration, Validation and Architecture, by startup Qubit Force.

s: Which startup unveiled 'The Anchorage' rocket testing facility at Space City in Tirupati district?
x: Bengaluru startup Ethereal Exploration Guild (The Guild) unveiled The Anchorage, for its Razor Crest Mk-1 reusable rocket.

s: Where is the headquarters of IN-SPACe?
x: IN-SPACe, set up in 2020, has its HQ at Ahmedabad; ISRO's HQ is Bengaluru.

s: In which year was the National Quantum Mission approved?
x: The National Quantum Mission was approved in April 2023 with ₹6,003.65 crore for 2023-24 to 2030-31.

s: Which company set the 28.95 km bituminous-concrete road record on the NH-544G Greenfield Highway?
x: Raj Path Infrastructure, headquartered in Maharashtra, set the NH-544G record; the certificate was presented to Puttaparthi MLA Palle Sindhura Reddy.

s: A 28.95 km bituminous concrete road was completed in 24 hours on which highway?
x: The record was set on NH-544G; bituminous concrete is bitumen with crushed stone aggregates forming the road's upper layer.

s: Where is the headquarters of the South Coast Railway zone, which began operations on 1 June 2026?
x: South Coast Railway, India's 18th zone, has its headquarters at Visakhapatnam.

s: Which of the following is NOT a division of the South Coast Railway zone?
x: SCoR's divisions are Guntakal, Guntur, Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam (renamed Waltair).

s: The Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram was built by GMR on which model?
x: GMR (GVIAL) built the airport on the DBFOT public-private partnership model.

s: In which district is the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
x: Bhogapuram airport, built by GMR and inaugurated by PM Modi on 1 August 2026, is in Vizianagaram district.

s: In which district did Raj Path Infrastructure lay 28.95 km of bituminous concrete road in 24 hours on NH-544G?
x: The Guinness record stretch started at Sadarlapalli, Puttaparthi constituency, Sri Sathya Sai district.

s: The NH-544G Greenfield Highway, where a Guinness World Record road was laid, is part of which expressway?
x: NH-544G is the Amaravati-Bengaluru Expressway greenfield highway.

s: South Coast Railway, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, is India's which railway zone?
x: SCoR began operations on 1 June 2026 as India's 18th railway zone.

s: On which date did PM Narendra Modi inaugurate the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
x: PM Modi inaugurated it on 1 August 2026; commercial operations began on 17 August 2026.

s: The Visakhapatnam division of the South Coast Railway zone was earlier known by which name?
x: The Waltair division was renamed Visakhapatnam division under SCoR, with HQ at Visakhapatnam.

s: Through which canal did Andhra Pradesh release Godavari water to Uttarandhra?
x: Andhra Pradesh released Godavari water to Uttarandhra through the Polavaram Left Main Canal. Uttarandhra Sujala Sravanthi is the linked project, while Pattiseema and Purushothapatnam are separate projects.

s: The Polavaram Left Main Canal, carrying about 2 TMC per day to Uttarandhra, is planned to link the Godavari with which river?
x: The plan is to link Godavari with Vamsadhara, not Krishna.

s: Which of the following statements correctly describes the movement of Godavari water in September 2026?
o: Water was sent to Rayalaseema through completed Polavaram tunnels after the dam was fully commissioned.
Godavari water was diverted only to Nallamala Sagar after completion of the main dam.
Krishna water was sent to North Coastal Andhra through the Right Main Canal without pumps.
Water was sent to North Coastal Andhra through the Left Main Canal using pumps, although the Polavaram dam itself was not finished.
x: In September 2026, Godavari water was sent to North Coastal Andhra through the Left Main Canal using pumps, even though the dam itself remained unfinished.

s: What water-sharing formula did Andhra Pradesh seek to continue with Telangana for the Krishna river waters until July 2027?
x: Andhra Pradesh sought continuation of the 66:34 formula with Telangana until July 2027. The 50:50 formula was Telangana’s demand, while 512:299 was the 2015 working split in TMC-ft.

s: At the meeting convened by the Union Ministry of Jal Shakti, for what purpose was the remaining Krishna water to be allocated?
x: The limited remaining water was to go to drinking and livestock needs, and crop allocation was ruled out.

s: The 66:34 Krishna-water sharing formula between Andhra Pradesh and Telangana originally began as what type of arrangement?
x: The 66:34 formula originally began as a one-year interim arrangement and continued for about 12 years. It was not initially framed as a five-year or ten-year permanent arrangement.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Krishna river-water sharing?
o: Article 262 assigns adjudication of inter-State river disputes to Parliament
The Krishna River Management Board was set up under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
One TMC-ft is approximately 28.32 billion cubic metres
The Inter-State River Water Disputes Act was enacted in 1956
x: One TMC-ft is about 28.32 million, not billion, cubic metres.

s: How much area are the Polavaram Left Main Canal works, carrying Godavari water to Uttarandhra, meant to irrigate?
x: The canal plan irrigates 4 lakh acres and provides drinking water to 9.23 lakh people.

s: About what share of Polavaram project works had been completed by 2019?
x: About 72% of Polavaram works were done by 2019; the diaphragm wall was damaged later.

s: With reference to the status of the Polavaram project, which of the following statements is incorrect?
o: About 72% of the works had been completed by 2019.
The diaphragm wall was damaged later.
About 82% of the works had been completed by 2019.
x: The incorrect statement changes the completion figure: about 72%, not 82%, of the works had been completed by 2019. The diaphragm wall was damaged later, and construction was accelerated after 2024.

s: How much Krishna water did the Krishna Water Disputes Tribunal-I (1976) allocate to undivided Andhra Pradesh?
x: KWDT-I gave 811 TMC-ft to undivided AP; in 2015 it was split 512 (AP) and 299 (Telangana).

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about reservations for urban local bodies in Andhra Pradesh?
o: BC General mayoral posts included Eluru, Anantapur and Chittoor
General Women reservation covered five Municipal Corporations
Among 106 municipalities, BC General chairperson posts numbered 20
x: BC General chairperson posts numbered 18, not 20.

s: Which Municipal Corporation's mayoral post is reserved for the Scheduled Tribes in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Mangalagiri–Tadepalli has the ST reservation; Kurnool is SC, Kakinada is BC Women and Tirupati is unreserved.

s: What is the length of the Vijayawada Metro Rail Phase-I approved by the State?
x: Vijayawada Phase-I is 38.40 km with 34 stations; Visakhapatnam has 4 corridors over 76.90 km.

s: How many Municipal Corporations' mayoral posts are reserved for General Women in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Five corporations (Vizianagaram, Srikakulam, Guntur, Kadapa, Visakhapatnam) are General Women; four are unreserved.

s: What is the length of the Visakhapatnam Metro Rail Phase-I approved by the State?
x: Visakhapatnam Metro Phase-I has 4 corridors of 76.90 km; Vijayawada has 38.40 km.

s: Mayor posts of which two Municipal Corporations of Andhra Pradesh are reserved for Scheduled Castes?
x: SC mayor posts: Rajamahendravaram and Kurnool; ST: Mangalagiri-Tadepalli.

s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for State Election Commissions for municipal elections?
x: Article 243ZA (Part IX-A) deals with elections to municipalities by the State Election Commission.

s: With reference to Andhra Pradesh tourism projects, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Suryalanka Beach – ₹77.91 crore; viewpoints and heritage walks
x: Simhachalam received ₹54.04 crore under PRASHAD. Akhanda Godavari had ₹94.44 crore, Gandikota ₹77.91 crore and Suryalanka Beach ₹97.52 crore under Swadesh Darshan 2.0.

s: What is the approximate value of the eight Centre-funded tourism projects nearing completion in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Eight Centre-funded projects worth about ₹428 crore were nearing completion; tourism was also given industrial status in the State.

s: What is the full form of PRASHAD, the scheme associated with pilgrimage and spiritual heritage development in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive
Pilgrimage Renewal and Sacred Heritage Advancement Programme
Pilgrim Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Development Drive
Pilgrimage Restoration and Sustainable Heritage Augmentation Scheme
x: PRASHAD stands for Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive. The other options alter the official wording, particularly terms such as “Renewal,” “Sacred,” or “Programme.”

s: Which is the costliest of the eight Centre-funded tourism projects in Andhra Pradesh?
x: Suryalanka Beach (₹97.52 crore) is the costliest; Akhanda Godavari got ₹94.44 crore.

s: Ahobilam's tourism project falls under Swadesh Darshan 2.0 in which theme?
x: Ahobilam is under Swadesh Darshan 2.0 as a spiritual project, not beach.

s: The restoration of which bridge is part of the Akhanda Godavari tourism project?
x: Akhanda Godavari (₹94.44 crore, Swadesh Darshan 2.0) includes Havelock Bridge restoration and Pushkar Ghat.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Palle Panduga 3.0?
o: The Centre's share was ₹5,694 crore and the State's ₹5,391 crore
It was launched on 29 September 2026 at Udayagiri in Nellore district
Phase 1.0 included 4,000 km of cement roads and 22,514 cattle sheds
Phase 1.0 included 21,000 farm ponds and horticulture on 64,000 acres
x: The shares are reversed: the Centre's share was ₹5,391 crore and the State's ₹5,694 crore.

s: What is the target for cement roads under Palle Panduga 3.0?
x: Cement roads target 6,000 km (₹2,700 crore), BT roads 9,500 km (₹7,550 crore) and Mini Gokulams 22,000 (₹300 crore).

s: Where was Palle Panduga 3.0 launched on 29 September 2026?
x: Palle Panduga 3.0 was launched at Udayagiri in Nellore district by CM Naidu and Dy CM Pawan Kalyan.

s: What is the total outlay of Palle Panduga 3.0?
x: The outlay is ₹11,085 crore: Centre ₹5,391 crore and State ₹5,694 crore.

s: What is the target for BT roads under Palle Panduga 3.0?
x: The BT road target is 9,500 km; cement roads are 6,000 km and Mini Gokulams 22,000.

s: The 31st CII Partnership Summit was held on 12–13 November 2026 at:
x: It was held at the Andhra University Engineering College grounds, Visakhapatnam, like the 30th edition in 2025.

s: What was the theme of the CII Partnership Summit 2026?
o: Building Bridges of Trust, Technology and Trade
Navigating New World Order: Trade, Technology, Trust
x: The 31st summit's theme was 'Navigating New World Order: Trade, Technology, Trust'.

s:
Consider the following about the CII Partnership Summit:
1. It has been held annually since 1995.
2. It is organised with DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
3. The 31st edition (2026) was the first held in Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: The 30th edition (2025) was also in Visakhapatnam, so 3 is wrong.

s: According to PTI, how many MoUs were signed during the two-day 31st CII Partnership Summit (2026), and of what value?
x: 109 MoUs worth ₹9.02 lakh crore; 194 MoUs were at the regional conferences, 73 MoUs + 15 G.O.s on Day 1; 410/₹9.8 lakh crore was the 2025 pre-summit target.

s: At the CII Partnership Summit 2026, Reliance Industries committed about ₹2.73 lakh crore in which district?
x: Reliance's ₹2.73 lakh crore commitment, the largest on Day 1, is in East Godavari.

s:
Match the CII Summit 2026 investors with the district of their project:
A. Kia India   B. GAIL India   C. JSW Group   D. Megha Engineering (renewables)
1. Srikakulam   2. Kadapa   3. Sri Sathya Sai   4. Krishna
x: Kia – Penukonda (Sri Sathya Sai); GAIL – Srikakulam; JSW – Kadapa; MEIL – Krishna.

s: AM Intelligence Labs' 512 MW green integrated AI data centre approved by the AP Cabinet in November 2026 involves an investment of about:
x: The Cabinet approved ₹31,387 crore for the 512 MW AI data centre in Visakhapatnam district.

s:
Match the companies (AP Cabinet, 10 Nov 2026) with their project locations:
A. Carbon Cosmo Advanced Materials   B. Epack Data Centre Solutions   C. Reliance Industries (AI data centre)
1. Rambilli, Anakapalli   2. Naidupeta, Tirupati   3. Vizianagaram
x: Carbon Cosmo – cathode complex at Naidupeta; Epack – Rambilli; Reliance – about 25 acres in Vizianagaram for a giga-scale AIDC.

s: Hwasin Automotive India, which signed an MoU with AP in November 2026 to make components for Kia cars, will set up its unit in which district?
x: Hwasin's ₹850 crore unit is in Sri Sathya Sai district; Iyamant India's ₹250 crore unit is in Kurnool.

s: INCOIS, which signed a tripartite MoU with Vignan's University and Ananth Technologies in November 2026, functions under which Ministry and where is it headquartered?
x: INCOIS was set up in 1999 under the Ministry of Earth Sciences, with HQ in Hyderabad; the MoU will use PFZ advisories.

s: Essar Renewables' proposed 300 MW hybrid project in Andhra Pradesh (about ₹4,500 crore) has a power purchase agreement with:
x: Essar Renewables signed a PPA with NHPC Ltd for the solar–wind–BESS project.

s:
Match the renewable energy projects in AP with their developers:
A. Pinnapuram Integrated RE Project   B. Upper Sileru PSP   C. Gandikota PSP
1. APGENCO   2. Greenko   3. Adani Renewable Energy
x: Pinnapuram (1,680 MW, Kurnool) – Greenko; Upper Sileru (1,350 MW) – APGENCO; Gandikota (1,000 MW) – Adani Renewable Energy.

s: In November 2026 Japanese company JERA signed a preliminary five-year agreement to buy green ammonia from Kakinada from:
x: JERA agreed with AM Green to buy 70,000 tonnes of green ammonia a year from Kakinada.

s: Andhra Pradesh's first Japanese Industrial Township is at:
x: Sri City, near the AP–Tamil Nadu border, hosts AP's first Japanese Industrial Township; Japan plans a second cluster.

s:
Consider the following about WIPO:
1. Its Convention was signed at Stockholm in 1967.
2. It became a UN specialised agency in 1974.
3. India joined WIPO in 1995.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: India joined WIPO in 1975, so 3 is wrong; WIPO is headquartered in Geneva.

s: In November 2026 the AP CM ordered restoration of 789 defunct lift irrigation schemes. Which body is to monitor and maintain them?
x: The Jalaharathi Corporation is to maintain the 789 schemes (₹632.07 crore) through a dedicated division.

s:
Match the lift irrigation schemes of AP with their water source:
A. Guru Raghavendra LIS   B. Taraka Rama Teertha Sagaram   C. Chintalapudi LIS   D. HNSS
1. Godavari   2. Champavathi   3. Tungabhadra   4. Krishna
x: Guru Raghavendra – Tungabhadra; Taraka Rama Teertha Sagaram – Champavathi; Chintalapudi – Godavari; HNSS – Krishna (Srisailam).

s:
Consider the following about the Handri–Neeva Sujala Sravanthi (HNSS) project:
1. It lifts Krishna water from the Srisailam reservoir.
2. It originates at Malyala in Kurnool district.
3. It mainly serves the North Coastal Andhra region.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
x: HNSS serves drought-prone Rayalaseema (about 6 lakh acres), not North Coastal Andhra.

s: The Polavaram Irrigation Project was declared a National Project under which section of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014?
x: Section 90 declares Polavaram a National Project; Sec. 84 = Apex Council, Sec. 85 = GRMB/KRMB, Sec. 89 = KWDT term.

s: One major objective of the Polavaram project is to transfer how much Godavari water to the Krishna basin?
x: Polavaram is meant to divert 80 TMC of Godavari water to the Krishna basin; 75.20 TMC is its live storage.

s: Which of the following was included in the renewable-energy transmission works associated with the July 2026 Andhra Pradesh projects package?
o: High-level bridge at Lingasamudram under NH-565
x: Kurnool-IV REZ Phase-I was included among the renewable-energy transmission works. The other options are highway projects, not renewable-energy transmission works.

s: Which one of the following National Highway works was included among the projects for which foundation stones were laid on 1 August 2026?
x: The projects included a bridge at Lingasamudram on NH-565. The other alternatives relate to railway or industrial infrastructure, not that National Highway package.

s: Who inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
x: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the airport; GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd is its developer.

s: Which of the following pairs about the Bhogapuram airport is correctly matched?
o: Developer – GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd
Phase I capacity – 16 lakh passengers per year
x: GMR Visakhapatnam International Airport Ltd is the developer. The airport is at Bhogapuram, Vizianagaram district, costs over ₹5,640 crore and has a capacity of about 60 lakh (6 million) passengers per year.

s: Which dance performance at the Bhogapuram airport event set a Guinness World Records achievement?
x: The Thimsa performance, a tribal folk dance of North Andhra and Odisha, was associated with the Guinness World Records achievement.

s: Which of the following statements about Bhogapuram airport is incorrect?
o: The airport is being developed under the greenfield PPP model at a cost of more than ₹5,640 crore.
The airport includes a 10 MW solar plant and its design is inspired by Chuttilu cottages and Araku Valley.
The airport will use AI-enabled operations, biometric processing and an Airport Predictive Operations Centre.
Its planned capacity is about 6 million passengers per year.
x: The incorrect statement is the one mentioning a 10 MW solar plant. Bhogapuram airport is planned with a 5 MW solar plant; its greenfield PPP model, capacity of about 6 million passengers per year and technology features are correctly stated.

s: After being notified as an Immigration Check Post, Bhogapuram became which airport in the Category-1 list?
x: Bhogapuram became the 39th airport in the Category-1 list, notified under the Immigration and Foreigners Act.

s: Where did the Prime Minister launch projects worth ₹17,900 crore?
x: The Prime Minister launched projects worth ₹17,900 crore at Bhogapuram on 1 August 2026.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport?
o: It replaced the civil enclave at INS Dega
It was described as the first greenfield airport since 2014
It was developed by the Airports Authority of India
x: The airport was developed by GMR through GVIAL, not by the Airports Authority of India.

s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport?
o: Initial capacity — 16 million passengers per annum
x: The airport's initial capacity is 6 million passengers per annum, not 16 million. Its location is Bhogapuram, its code is VTZ and its runway is 3,800 metres long.

s: Which heliport received India's first private Point-in-Space (PinS) Instrument Approach Procedure approval?
x: Undavalli Heliport received the approval; the procedure was developed by AAI to ICAO standards.

s: GAGAN (GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation), used for the Undavalli Heliport's navigation procedure, was developed by which bodies?
x: GAGAN is a GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation system developed by ISRO and AAI.

s: The Recharla–Guravayigudem expressway inaugurated on 1 August 2026 lies on which National Highway?
x: The expressway is on the Khammam–Devarapalli NH-365BG; NH-67 has the Tadipatri bypass.

s: What is the capacity of the Kurnool-IV Renewable Energy Zone, whose transmission foundation was laid on 1 August 2026?
x: Kurnool-IV REZ is 4.5 GW; 2,500 MW and 1,000 MW are the Anantapur and Kurnool zones.

s: What is the runway length of the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram?
x: The airport has a 3,800 m runway and can withstand 275 kmph winds.

s: As which railway zone of India did South Coast Railway begin operations on 1 June 2026?
x: SCoR, headquartered at Visakhapatnam, became the 18th railway zone.

s: When did commercial flights begin at the Bhogapuram (Alluri Sitarama Raju) International Airport?
x: PM Modi dedicated the airport on 1 August 2026; commercial flights moved from Vizag on 17 August 2026.

s: Which body granted the Undavalli Heliport India's first private Point-in-Space (PinS) instrument approach approval?
x: The approval was granted by DGCA; the procedure was developed by AAI to ICAO standards.

s: A rail line to the port at the revived Kakinada SEZ is proposed from which station?
x: A rail line is proposed from Annavaram station to the port; the Bharatmala NH also passes through the KSEZ.

s: From which place to which place was the headquarters of the Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board shifted?
x: The headquarters of the Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board was shifted from Kakinada to Amaravati. The Directorate of Ports was also shifted to Amaravati, while the Board manages non-major ports.

s: What happened to the Kakinada Special Economic Zone, also known as Auro Industrial City, in July 2026?
o: It was revived after two decades
It was converted into the Kakinada Gateway Port
It became the APEX Korea overseas centre
It was inaugurated as Rayalaseema Steel Limited
x: The Kakinada Special Economic Zone, also called Auro Industrial City, was revived after two decades. The Kakinada Gateway Port, APEX Korea and Rayalaseema Steel Limited are separate developments.

s: What is the approximate investment in the MoUs of the revived Kakinada Special Economic Zone?
x: The MoUs total about ₹1.5 lakh crore with potential for 1.5 lakh direct and indirect jobs.

s: Under the Special Economic Zones Act, 2005, how is a Special Economic Zone characterised?
o: A duty-free enclave treated as outside the customs territory
A duty-free enclave treated as within the customs territory
A notified zone limited to about 10 industries
x: A Special Economic Zone is a duty-free enclave treated as outside the customs territory under the SEZ Act, 2005. The description of a zone treated as within the customs territory reverses this key characteristic.

s: Which body manages the non-major ports of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The AP Maritime Board (est. 2019), now shifted to Amaravati, manages non-major ports.

s: The Centre granted in-principle approval to which proposed project at Dugarajapatnam in Tirupati district?
x: The Centre granted in-principle approval to the Dugarajapatnam greenfield shipbuilding cluster. The Underground Coal Gasification complex is proposed in Eluru district, while the lithium and gallium initiative is an exploration pact.

s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Orvakal Drone City?
o: A special committee was asked to act on industry demands within 6 months
It is expected to create about 5,000 direct and 25,000 indirect jobs
In Phase 1, 12 plots were identified and 8 allotted
India needs more than 6 lakh drones against about 40,000 available
x: The special committee was to act on industry demands within 3 months, not 6.

s: In which valley do the Chintalapudi and Recharla coal blocks, proposed for Underground Coal Gasification in Eluru district, lie?
x: The blocks hold about 3,130.61 MT of coal deeper than 600 m in the Godavari Valley; UCG converts coal in situ into syngas of H₂ and CO.

s: The Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park, planned by APIIC near the Tamil Nadu border, is in which district?
x: APIIC plans the Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park in Chittoor district near the Tamil Nadu border, with Sri City as its model.

s: India’s first integrated Underground Coal Gasification (UCG) complex has been proposed in which district of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The first integrated UCG complex is proposed in Eluru district; Tirupati district hosts the Dugarajapatnam shipbuilding cluster.

s: Which became India's first major private-sector gold mine to start commercial production since Independence?
x: Swarnagiri became the first major private-sector gold mine in India to start commercial production since Independence.

s: By what name did Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu rename the Jonnagiri Gold Mine in Kurnool district?
x: The Jonnagiri Gold Mine, operated by Geomysore Services in Tuggali mandal, was renamed Swarnagiri Gold Mine.

s: For what is Orvakal Drone City in Kurnool district planned as a national hub?
o: Drone manufacturing, R&D, testing and training
x: Orvakal Drone City is planned as a national hub for drone manufacturing, research and development, testing and training.

s: The Orvakal Drone City project is being developed through a partnership between the Andhra Pradesh Government and which Union ministry?
o: Union Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
x: The partners are the Andhra Pradesh Government and the Union Ministry of Civil Aviation. The Ministry of Coal, the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways, and the Ministry of Mines are associated with other subjects in the facts.

s: Which of the following project–location pairs in Rayalaseema is correctly matched?
o: DRDO AMCA integration and flight-testing centre – Near Tirupati
x: JSW’s integrated steel plant is at Kadapa; the KIA plant is at Penukonda in Sri Sathya Sai district (earlier Anantapur), Royal Enfield near Tirupati and the DRDO AMCA centre at Puttaparthi.

s: Which of the following correctly describes the early industrial base of Rayalaseema?
x: Rayalaseema’s early industries included cotton ginning and textiles. The other options refer to sectors associated with later investment proposals and industrial developments, not its early industrial base.

s: The Bharat Forge defence energetics project in Rayalaseema is located at which place?
x: Bharat Forge’s defence energetics project is located at Madakasira. Kadapa, Sri City and Puttaparthi are associated with other projects or industrial developments.

s: From which project is water for the Kosala Nagaram Industrial Park to come, via a balancing reservoir?
x: Supply is planned from Galeru Nagari Sujala Sravanthi through a balancing reservoir, scheduled by December 2028.

s: Which of the following was listed along with Bengaluru, Pune, Surat and Varanasi among the other cities under the City Economic Region scheme?
x: Bhubaneswar–Puri–Cuttack was one of the other city regions listed under the scheme. The other combinations refer to districts, the semiconductor project location or places connected with the inscriptions.

s: Which of the following correctly describes Orvakal industrial development?
o: A CBIC node of 13,919.67 acres with a 2,621-acre space city
A VCIC node of 33,000 acres with a 600-acre food park
A steel hub of 8.2 MTPA with a 2,000-acre aerospace park
An HBIC node of 2,621 acres with a 600-acre Drone City
x: Orvakal is an HBIC node covering 2,621 acres and includes a 600-acre Drone City.

s: Which of the following is NOT included among the industrial developments associated with Rayalaseema?
o: AM/NS India plant at Rajayyapeta near Anakapalli
x: Kia, Royal Enfield and Orvakal Drone City are listed among Rayalaseema’s industrial developments. The AM/NS India plant at Rajayyapeta is near Anakapalli, outside that list.

s: Where is the AMCA facility located in the Rayalaseema industrial hub?
x: The AMCA facility is at Puttaparthi. Orvakal has the Drone City, Kopparthy is the mega industrial hub becoming an electronics cluster, and a Space City is proposed near Sriharikota.

s: How much does each selected city receive under the City Economic Region scheme?
x: Each city receives ₹5,000 crore: ₹3,500 crore from the Centre and ₹1,500 crore in State loans.

s: Which of the following BHAVYA parks is NOT correctly matched with its location?
x: Veldurthi textiles is associated with Palnadu, not Prakasam. Space City, Drone City and the Makavaripalem food park are correctly matched.

s: What is the proposed investment for Reliance's Underground Coal Gasification complex in Eluru district?
x: Reliance's UCG complex is about ₹2.73 lakh crore over 30 years in 3 phases.

s: What is the Phase I capacity of JSW Rayalaseema Steel at Kadapa?
x: Phase I is 1 MTPA, expanded to 2 MTPA in Phase II.

s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: First private-sector primary gold mine — Kakinada
Autonomous maritime shipbuilding centre — Tirupati district
First private-sector primary gold mine — Jonnagiri, Kurnool
x: Geomysore Services is associated with the first private-sector primary gold mine at Jonnagiri in Kurnool district.

s: Which JSW project in Rayalaseema was inaugurated by Chief Minister Naidu on July 3, 2026?
o: HFCL high-precision ammunition unit, Sri Sathya Sai district
x: JSW Rayalaseema Steel Limited at Kadapa was inaugurated by Chief Minister Naidu on July 3, 2026. The other options refer to separate automobile, space and defence projects in Rayalaseema.

s: Where is the electronics mega cluster of Rayalaseema located?
x: The electronics cluster (mega hub) is at Kopparthy; Orvakal has the Drone City.

s: Where is the KIA Motors car plant in Andhra Pradesh located?
x: The KIA plant is at Penukonda in Sri Sathya Sai district (earlier Anantapur).

s: Which company operates the Swarnagiri (Jonnagiri) Gold Mine in Kurnool district?
x: Geomysore Services runs the mine, the first major private gold mine in commercial production since Independence.

s: In which basin are lithium and gallium being explored under the AP–CSIR-NGRI pact of August 2026?
x: The pact covers lithium and gallium near Tummalapalle in the Cuddapah Basin, funded by the NMET.

s: Which body is the State nodal agency for BHAVYA industrial parks in Andhra Pradesh?
x: APIIC (est. 1973, Mangalagiri) is the State nodal agency for BHAVYA.

s: In which district is the Tekulodu Aerospace and Defence park under BHAVYA?
x: Tekulodu Aerospace & Defence park is in Sri Sathya Sai district.

s: Which city of Andhra Pradesh was selected under the City Economic Region (CER) scheme?
x: Visakhapatnam was selected; each city gets ₹5,000 crore (₹3,500 crore Centre + ₹1,500 crore State).

s: Underground coal gasification, proposed by Reliance in Eluru district, converts coal into which gas?
x: UCG turns coal into syngas, mainly hydrogen (H₂) and carbon monoxide (CO).

s: Which body fully funds the lithium and gallium exploration in the Cuddapah Basin under the AP–CSIR-NGRI pact?
